page.overview:
Who is Cleff?

Cleff is a shopkeep that runs the at the in . Cleff has a serious demeanor, in contrast with his sister excitable personality. He also shares that they sell , encouraging to grab whatever he wants to buy.

If asks about the store, Cleff explains that Coral Reef is a where one can buy fresh . While they do sell , due to the Zora's weakness to electricity, they don't stock .

When asked about business, Cleff will admit that things haven't been great. He initially tells that he's worried about the Coral Reef's business, since there aren't many travelers coming by to make purchases. After has been calmed, Cleff will remark that business is improving, and he no longer believes that he will have to close his shop.

Cleff will accept that Link wants to sell. When Link ends their business at night, Cleff warns him to be careful going out after dark.
